g.text: about • A1 • haqqında • regarding • This book is about animals.
activity • A1 • fəaliyyət • task, action • Playing football is an activity.
again • A1 • yenidən • once more • Please try again.
age • A1 • yaş • years, time of life • What is your age?
answer • A1 • cavab • reply, response • I know the answer.
around • A1 • ətrafında • nearby • We walked around the park.
ask • A1 • soruşmaq • question, inquire • I want to ask a question.
awesome • A2 • möhtəşəm • amazing • Your drawing is awesome!
ballet • A2 • balet • dance • She dances ballet every Saturday.
